title: Notice Channel and Mailing Days for Prior Authorization Deadline Extensions
content:
**Notice standard.** The mailing days of a member-requested deadline extension follow the notice channel on the member's plan membership: where notices go by mail, the class's decision-notice mailing business days are turned into calendar days by multiplying them by seven, dividing by five and rounding up to a whole day; where notices go by email, the mailing days are one day; where notices go by any other channel, the mailing business days are counted as calendar days.

The notice channel is the one recorded on the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership. The mailing days are part of the days a member-requested deadline extension on a Prior Authorization request adds.

## Channel table

| Notice channel on the membership | Mailing days |
|---|---|
| mail | the class's mailing business days multiplied by seven, divided by five, rounded up to a whole day |
| email | 1 day |
| any other channel | the class's mailing business days, each counted as one calendar day |

## Worked conversions (hypothetical business-day figures)

| Mailing business days | By mail | By email | Other channel |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 3 multiplied by seven is 21, divided by five is 4.2, rounded up to 5 | 1 | 3 |
| 4 | 28 divided by five is 5.6, rounded up to 6 | 1 | 4 |
| 5 | 35 divided by five is exactly 7 | 1 | 5 |

Rounding is always up, and it happens once, after the division.
